    def render_master_video(
        self,
        schedule: TimelineSchedule,
        ass_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
        audio_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        format: str = "f2",
        format_plan: Optional[FormatPlan] = None,
        layout_profile: Optional[LayoutProfile] = None
    ) -> RenderMetrics:
        """
        Executes single-pass GPU NVENC master render with burned-in ASS subtitles and audio.
        Supports rich atmospheric HUD for story formats (F4, F3, F2, F2-L) and clean stream composition for F1.
        """
        start_time = time.time()
        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        from ...models import FormatId, SourceClass, TimelineSchedule, create_default_format_plan
        from ...format_validator import FormatValidator
        from ...format_semantics import normalize_format
        format_id = normalize_format(format)
        format = format_id.value
        format_plan = format_plan or create_default_format_plan(format_id)
        FormatValidator.validate_timeline(schedule.segments, format_plan)
        f4_background = next((s.source_path for s in schedule.segments if s.source_class == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE), None) if format_id == FormatId.F4 else None
        render_segments = [s for s in schedule.segments if not (format_id == FormatId.F4 and s.source_class == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE)]
        if format_id == FormatId.F4 and not f4_background:
            raise FileNotFoundError("F4 requires a selected online stock background source")
        if f4_background and not f4_background.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required F4 online background source is missing: {f4_background}")
        original_schedule = schedule
        for seg in render_segments:
            if not seg.source_path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required {seg.source_class.value} source is missing: {seg.source_path}")
            if seg.background_source_path and not seg.background_source_path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required F4 online background source is missing: {seg.background_source_path}")
        master_audio = audio_path or schedule.audio_path
        if not master_audio or not Path(master_audio).exists():
            # Auto-detect audio from story directory
            story_d = schedule.story_dir if schedule.story_dir.exists() else self.work_dir.parent
            for ext in ("*.m4a", "*.mp3", "*.wav"):
                audios = list(story_d.glob(ext))
                if audios:
                    master_audio = audios[0]
                    break

        # 1. Normalize all segments
        if format_id == FormatId.F4:
            self._f4_background_path = f4_background
            schedule = TimelineSchedule(schedule.story_dir, schedule.audio_path, schedule.total_duration, render_segments)
        seg_paths = self.normalize_all_segments(schedule)
        schedule = original_schedule
        self._f4_background_path = None

        # 2. Write concat file
        concat_file = self.work_dir / "concat_segments.txt"
        with open(concat_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for p in seg_paths:
                safe_p = str(p.resolve()).replace("\\", "/")
                f.write(f"file '{safe_p}'\n")

        # 3. Format ASS subtitle path for FFmpeg filter
        has_ass = ass_path and Path(ass_path).exists() and Path(ass_path).stat().st_size > 0
        escaped_ass = str(Path(ass_path).resolve()).replace("\\", "/").replace(":", "\\:") if has_ass else ""

        # 4. Filter configuration based on format
        inputs = [
            "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", str(concat_file),
            "-i", str(master_audio)
        ]

        if format.lower() == "f1":
            if has_ass:
                filter_complex = f"[0:v]ass='{escaped_ass}'[v_final]"
                map_args = ["-filter_complex", filter_complex, "-map", "[v_final]", "-map", "1:a"]
            else:
                map_args = ["-map", "0:v", "-map", "1:a"]
        else:
            # Prepare Radio HUD and Snow Overlay for Story Formats (F4, F3, F2, F2-L)
            snow_overlay = Path(r"D:\Video\assets\overlays\snow_1080p.mp4")
            if not snow_overlay.exists():
                snow_orig = Path(r"D:\Video\assets\overlays\snow_falling_124280.mp4")
                if snow_orig.exists():
                    snow_overlay = snow_orig

            from ..stage3_compose.motion_slideshow import CinematicMotionEngine
            motion_engine = CinematicMotionEngine(width=DEFAULT_WIDTH, height=DEFAULT_HEIGHT, fps=DEFAULT_FPS)
            radio_hud_png = self.work_dir / "radio_hud.png"
            motion_engine.create_radio_hud_overlay(radio_hud_png)

            if snow_overlay.exists() and radio_hud_png.exists():
                inputs.extend([
                    "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", str(snow_overlay),
                    "-loop", "1", "-i", str(radio_hud_png)
                ])
                fc_ass = f"[v_wave]ass='{escaped_ass}'[v_final]" if has_ass else "[v_wave]null[v_final]"
                filter_complex = (
                    "[0:v]format=gbrp[base];"
                    "[2:v]scale=1920:1080,format=gbrp[snow];"
                    "[base][snow]blend=all_mode='screen':all_opacity=0.75,format=yuv420p[v_snow];"
                    "[1:a]asplit=2[a_main][a_wave];"
                    "[a_wave]showwaves=s=460x65:mode=line:colors=0x00E6FF@0.95:scale=cbrt,format=yuva420p[wave];"
                    "[v_snow][3:v]overlay=0:0[v_hud];"
                    f"[v_hud][wave]overlay=x=1420:y=82[v_wave];"
                    f"{fc_ass}"
                )
                map_args = ["-filter_complex", filter_complex, "-map", "[v_final]", "-map", "[a_main]"]
            else:
                if has_ass:
                    filter_complex = f"[0:v]ass='{escaped_ass}'[v_final]"
                    map_args = ["-filter_complex", filter_complex, "-map", "[v_final]", "-map", "1:a"]
                else:
                    map_args = ["-map", "0:v", "-map", "1:a"]

        # 5. Master FFmpeg NVENC command
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            *inputs,
            *map_args,
            "-c:v", NVENC_CODEC,
            "-preset", NVENC_PRESET,
            "-b:v", NVENC_BITRATE,
            "-maxrate", NVENC_MAXRATE,
            "-c:a", "aac",
            "-b:a", NVENC_AUDIO_BITRATE,
            "-ar", NVENC_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE,
            "-shortest",
            str(output_path)
        ]

        from ...process_manager import process_manager
        proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        process_manager.register_render_process(proc, story_name=schedule.story_dir.name, job_type="master_render")

        stdout, stderr = proc.communicate()
        process_manager.unregister_render_process()

        if proc.returncode != 0 and process_manager.is_cancelling:
            raise RuntimeError("Render job was cancelled by user.")

        # Fallback to CPU libx264 if NVENC failed (e.g. driver issue or no hardware support)
        if (proc.returncode != 0 or not output_path.exists() or output_path.stat().st_size < 10000) and not process_manager.is_cancelling:
            cmd_cpu = [
                "ffmpeg", "-y",
                *inputs,
                *map_args,
                "-c:v", "libx264",
                "-preset", "veryfast",
                "-crf", "20",
                "-c:a", "aac",
                "-b:a", NVENC_AUDIO_BITRATE,
                "-ar", NVENC_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE,
                "-shortest",
                str(output_path)
            ]
            proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd_cpu, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            process_manager.register_render_process(proc, story_name=schedule.story_dir.name, job_type="master_render_cpu_fallback")
            stdout, stderr = proc.communicate()
            process_manager.unregister_render_process()

        if not output_path.exists() or output_path.stat().st_size < 10000:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Master render failed (code {proc.returncode}): {stderr[-500:]}")

        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        file_size = output_path.stat().st_size
        total_frames = schedule.total_duration * DEFAULT_FPS
        avg_fps = total_frames / max(1.0, elapsed)

        # Compute output SHA-256 and emit RunManifest
        out_sha256 = ""
        try:
            h = hashlib.sha256()
            with open(output_path, "rb") as f:
                while chunk := f.read(65536):
                    h.update(chunk)
            out_sha256 = h.hexdigest()
        except Exception:
            pass

        from ...format_evidence import write_render_evidence
        write_render_evidence(schedule, format_id.value, output_path)

        assets_used = []
        for s in schedule.segments:
            s_class = getattr(s, "source_class", None)
            s_class_str = s_class.value if hasattr(s_class, "value") else (str(s_class) if s_class else "UNKNOWN")
            assets_used.append({
                "index": s.index,
                "type": s.segment_type,
                "source_path": str(s.source_path),
                "source_class": s_class_str,
                "asset_id": getattr(s, "asset_id", "") or Path(s.source_path).stem,
                "duration": s.duration
            })

        from ...models import RunManifest
        fmt_val = format.upper() if isinstance(format, str) else (format.value if hasattr(format, "value") else str(format))
        story_name = schedule.story_dir.name if hasattr(schedule, "story_dir") and schedule.story_dir else "story"

"""
Unified Command Line Interface for videopipeline.
Adheres to CADS execution reproducibility standards.
"""
import sys
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

if sys.stdout and hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):

if sys.stderr and hasattr(sys.stderr, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

def resolve_story_assets(story_dir: Path):
    """Finds audio and srt files inside the story folder."""
    audio_files = list(story_dir.glob("*.m4a")) + list(story_dir.glob("*.mp3")) + list(story_dir.glob("*.wav"))
    if not audio_files:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No audio file (.m4a/.mp3/.wav) found in {story_dir}")
    audio_path = audio_files[0]

    srt_files = list(story_dir.glob("*.srt"))
    if not srt_files:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No .srt file found in {story_dir}")
    srt_path = srt_files[0]

    return audio_path, srt_path

def cmd_ingest(args):
    story_dir = Path(args.story_dir)
    audio_path, srt_path = resolve_story_assets(story_dir)
    print(f"[Ingest] Found Audio: {audio_path.name}")
    print(f"[Ingest] Found Subtitles: {srt_path.name}")

    cues = parse_srt_file(srt_path)
    total_dur = cues[-1].end_sec if cues else 0.0
    plan = plan_story_scenes(total_dur, cues)

    print(f"[Ingest] Parsed {len(cues)} subtitle cues.")
    print(f"[Ingest] Total Duration: {total_dur:.2f}s ({total_dur/60:.2f} mins)")
    print(f"[Ingest] Body Segments: {plan['num_body_segments']} (Stock: {plan['stock_slots_required']}, AI: {plan['ai_slots_required']})")

def cmd_assets(args):
    story_dir = Path(args.story_dir)
    print(f"[Assets] Inspecting assets for: {story_dir.name}")

    # Stock verification
    stock_mgr = StockManager(get_story_stock_dirs(story_dir))
    print(f"[Assets] Total Stock Clips: {stock_mgr.total_count} (Unused: {stock_mgr.unused_count})")

    # Veo Client verification
    veo_client = GoogleFlowVeoClient()
    val = veo_client.validate_cookie()
    if val["valid"]:
        print(f"[Assets] Google Flow Cookie: VALID (SID present)")
    else:
        print(f"[Assets] Google Flow Cookie: INVALID -> {val.get('error')}")

    veo_dir = story_dir / "veo_clips"
    existing_veo = veo_client.get_existing_veo_clips(veo_dir)
    print(f"[Assets] Existing Veo 3.1 AI Clips: {len(existing_veo)}")

def cmd_compose(args):
    story_dir = Path(args.story_dir)
    audio_path, srt_path = resolve_story_assets(story_dir)
    work_dir = story_dir / "fast_pipeline"
    work_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    cues = parse_srt_file(srt_path)
    total_dur = cues[-1].end_sec if cues else 0.0

    # 1. Build ASS Subtitle
    ass_path = work_dir / "master_karaoke.ass"
    generate_karaoke_ass(cues, ass_path, include_hud=True, total_duration=total_dur)
    print(f"[Compose] Generated ASS Subtitles: {ass_path} ({ass_path.stat().st_size} bytes)")

    # 2. Build Schedule
    stock_mgr = StockManager(get_story_stock_dirs(story_dir))
    veo_client = GoogleFlowVeoClient()
    veo_clips = veo_client.get_existing_veo_clips(story_dir / "veo_clips")
    chap1_candidate = story_dir / "Final_Video_Export" / "Phase1_Prototype_3M.mp4"

    fmt_str = getattr(args, "format", "f2").upper()
    if fmt_str == "F2-L":
        fmt_str = "F2"
    from .models import FormatId, RunRequest, create_default_format_plan, EditorialVerdict
    from .format_validator import FormatValidator
    from .stages.stage3_compose.editorial_qc import EditorialQC
    import json

    from .format_semantics import normalize_format
    fmt_id = normalize_format(fmt_str)
    from .format_semantics import FORMAT_SEMANTICS
    print(f"[Compose] Selected {fmt_id.value}: {FORMAT_SEMANTICS[fmt_id]}")
    format_plan = create_default_format_plan(fmt_id)
    run_req = RunRequest(story_dir=story_dir, format_id=fmt_id, format_plan=format_plan)

    tb = TimelineBuilder(story_dir, audio_path, total_dur)
    sched = tb.build_schedule(
        chap1_source=chap1_candidate if chap1_candidate.exists() and fmt_id != FormatId.F4 else None,
        stock_clips=stock_mgr.get_stock_pool(),
        veo_clips=veo_clips,
        format=fmt_str.lower()
    )

    from .format_evidence import validate_bound_sources
    validate_bound_sources(sched)

    # Format Grammar Validation
    FormatValidator.validate_timeline(sched.segments, format_plan)

    # Stage 3 Editorial QC Gate
    qc_res = EditorialQC.evaluate_timeline(sched.segments, total_dur, format_plan)
    qc_path = work_dir / "editorial_qc_report.json"
    with open(qc_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(qc_res.to_dict(), f, indent=2)

    accept_override = getattr(args, "accept_override", False)
    if qc_res.verdict == EditorialVerdict.NEEDS_OWNER and not accept_override:
        print(f"[Compose] âš ï¸ EditorialQC verdict: NEEDS_OWNER")
        for r in qc_res.reasons:
            print(f"  - {r}")
        print("[Compose] Pipeline paused. Pass --accept-override to continue render.")
        sched.editorial_qc_verdict = qc_res.verdict.value
        sched.owner_disposition = "PENDING"
    elif accept_override and qc_res.verdict != EditorialVerdict.EDIT_READY:
        sched.editorial_qc_verdict = qc_res.verdict.value
        sched.owner_disposition = "ACCEPT_OVERRIDE"
        print("[Compose] ðŸ›¡ï¸ Owner override applied (ACCEPT_OVERRIDE).")
    else:
        sched.editorial_qc_verdict = qc_res.verdict.value
        sched.owner_disposition = "AUTO"
        print(f"[Compose] âœ… EditorialQC passed: {qc_res.verdict.value}")

    sched_path = work_dir / "video_schedule.json"
    tb.save_schedule_json(sched, sched_path)
    print(f"[Compose] Generated Schedule: {sched_path} ({len(sched.segments)} segments)")

def cmd_render(args):
    story_dir = Path(args.story_dir)
    work_dir = story_dir / "fast_pipeline"
    sched_path = work_dir / "video_schedule.json"
    ass_path = work_dir / "master_karaoke.ass"
    out_dir = story_dir / "Final_Video_Export"
    out_file = out_dir / (args.output_name or "Full_Master_Video_26M.mp4")

    if not sched_path.exists() or not ass_path.exists():
        print("[Render] Missing schedule or ASS file. Run compose first.")
        return

    # Load schedule
    import json
    from .models import TimelineSchedule, VisualSegment, SourceClass
    with open(sched_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    segments = [
        VisualSegment(
            index=s["index"],
            start_time=s["start"],
            duration=s["duration"],
            segment_type=s["type"],
            source_path=Path(s["source"]),
            description=s.get("description", ""),
            source_class=SourceClass(s["source_class"]) if s.get("source_class") else None,
            asset_id=s.get("asset_id", ""),
            background_source_path=Path(s["background_source"]) if s.get("background_source") else None
        )
        for s in data["segments"]
    ]
    schedule = TimelineSchedule(
        story_dir=Path(data["story_dir"]),
        audio_path=Path(data["audio_path"]),
        total_duration=data["total_duration"],
        segments=segments
    )

    qc_verdict = data.get("editorial_qc_verdict", "PASS")
    owner_disp = data.get("owner_disposition", "AUTO")
    accept_override = getattr(args, "accept_override", False)

    if qc_verdict == "NEEDS_OWNER" and not accept_override and owner_disp != "ACCEPT_OVERRIDE":
        print("[Render] âŒ Blocked by EditorialQC: NEEDS_OWNER. Use --accept-override to proceed.")
        return

    if accept_override and qc_verdict != "EDIT_READY":
        schedule.editorial_qc_verdict = qc_verdict
        schedule.owner_disposition = "ACCEPT_OVERRIDE"
    else:
        schedule.editorial_qc_verdict = qc_verdict
        schedule.owner_disposition = owner_disp

    print(f"[Render] Starting NVENC Render Engine...")
    print(f"[Render] Target Output: {out_file}")
    engine = NvencRenderEngine(work_dir)
    from .format_semantics import normalize_format
    metrics = engine.render_master_video(schedule, ass_path, out_file, format=normalize_format(getattr(args, "format", "f2")).value)
    print(f"[Render] COMPLETE!")
    print(f"  Duration: {metrics.duration_sec:.2f}s")
    print(f"  File Size: {metrics.file_size_bytes:,} bytes")
    print(f"  Render Time: {metrics.render_time_sec:.1f}s ({metrics.render_time_sec/60:.2f} mins)")
    print(f"  Average FPS: {metrics.average_encoding_fps:.1f} FPS")

        print(f"[QA] Error: Video file not found: {video_file}")

    print(f"[QA] Verifying: {video_file.name}")

    print(f"  Resolution: {meta.get('width')}x{meta.get('height')}")
    print(f"  FPS: {meta.get('fps')}")
    print(f"  Duration: {meta.get('duration'):.2f}s")
    print(f"  Video Codec: {meta.get('video_codec')}")
    print(f"  Audio Codec: {meta.get('audio_codec')}")

    from .format_evidence import recheck_render_evidence
    from .models import TimelineSchedule, VisualSegment, SourceClass
    schedule_file = story_dir / "fast_pipeline" / "video_schedule.json"
    evidence_file = out_dir / "format_evidence.json"
    if schedule_file.is_file():
        data = json.loads(schedule_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        schedule = TimelineSchedule(
            story_dir=Path(data["story_dir"]), audio_path=Path(data["audio_path"]),
            total_duration=data["total_duration"],
            segments=[VisualSegment(
                index=s["index"], start_time=s["start"], duration=s["duration"],
                segment_type=s["type"], source_path=Path(s["source"]),
                description=s.get("description", ""),
                source_class=SourceClass(s["source_class"]) if s.get("source_class") else None,
                asset_id=s.get("asset_id", ""),
                background_source_path=Path(s["background_source"]) if s.get("background_source") else None,
            ) for s in data["segments"]]
        )
        result = recheck_render_evidence(schedule, args.format, evidence_file)
        print(f"  Format evidence: {result['status']} â€” {result['reason']}")
    else:
        print("  Format evidence: NEEDS_OWNER â€” composed schedule is missing.")

    previews_dir = out_dir / "previews_v2"
    timestamps = [
        ("00:01:30", "qa_01_chap1.jpg"),
        ("00:03:45", "qa_02_body_veo01.jpg"),
        ("00:07:45", "qa_03_body_veo05.jpg"),
        ("00:16:45", "qa_04_body_veo14.jpg"),
        ("00:25:45", "qa_05_body_veo23.jpg"),
    ]
    extracted = QAVerifier.extract_preview_frames(video_file, previews_dir, timestamps)
    print(f"[QA] Extracted {len(extracted)} preview frames in {previews_dir}")

def cmd_run(args):
    """Executes all stages sequentially."""
    print("=== [Stage 1: Ingest] ===")
    cmd_ingest(args)
    print("\n=== [Stage 2: Assets] ===")
    cmd_assets(args)
    print("\n=== [Stage 3: Compose] ===")
    cmd_compose(args)
    if args.dry_run:
        print("\n[Run] Dry-run enabled. Skipping render stage.")
        return
    print("\n=== [Stage 4: Render] ===")
    cmd_render(args)
    print("\n=== [Stage 5: QA] ===")
    cmd_qa(args)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command:
        parser.print_help()

"""
Timeline schedule builder for videopipeline.
Compiles deterministic visual timelines for canonical Five Formats (F1-F5)
with zero-reuse persistent registry and source grammar validation.
"""
import json
import logging
import random
import re
from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Union

from ...models import (
    VisualSegment, TimelineSchedule, FormatId, SourceClass,
    FormatPlan, create_default_format_plan, CreativePlan, ShotSpec
)
from ...config import F2_CHAPTER1_DURATION, F2_SEGMENT_DURATION
from ...clip_registry import filter_unused, record_clips, get_registry_stats
from ...format_validator import FormatValidator
from ...format_semantics import normalize_format

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class TimelineBuilder:
    """
    Builds the master visual timeline schedule according to the bound FormatPlan.
    Enforces canonical format rules without arbitrary fixed 30s cadence.
    Guarantees that NO clip is ever reused within a video or across past video runs.
    """

    def __init__(self, story_dir: Path, audio_path: Path, total_duration: float):
        self.story_dir = story_dir
        self.audio_path = audio_path
        self.total_duration = total_duration

    def build_schedule(
        self,
        chap1_source: Optional[Path] = None,
        stock_clips: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        veo_clips: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        format: Union[str, FormatPlan] = "f2",
        images: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        body_scenes: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        creative_plan: Optional[CreativePlan] = None,
        validate: bool = True
    ) -> TimelineSchedule:
        """
        Assembles all segments into a complete timeline matching total_duration.
        Supports canonical F1, F2, F3, F4, F5 (and backward-compatible F2-L).
        """
        stock_clips = stock_clips or []
        veo_clips = veo_clips or []

        # Resolve FormatPlan
        if isinstance(format, FormatPlan):
            format_plan = format
            fmt_id = format_plan.format_id
        else:
            fmt_id = normalize_format(format)
            format_plan = create_default_format_plan(fmt_id)

        # â”€â”€ Filter out globally-used clips â”€â”€
        if self.story_dir.name.startswith("dummy") or not self.story_dir.exists():
            fresh_stock = list(stock_clips)
        else:
            fresh_stock = filter_unused(stock_clips)
        fresh_veo = list(veo_clips)

        # Separate story custom stock and library stock
        story_custom_stock = [c for c in fresh_stock if str(self.story_dir).lower() in str(c).lower()]
        library_stock = [c for c in fresh_stock if str(self.story_dir).lower() not in str(c).lower()]
        random.shuffle(story_custom_stock)
        random.shuffle(library_stock)
        ordered_stock = story_custom_stock + library_stock
        stock_queue = deque(ordered_stock)

        # Veo clips queue
        has_numbered_shots = any(re.search(r"shot_\d+", p.stem.lower()) for p in fresh_veo)
        veo_sorted = sorted(fresh_veo, key=lambda p: p.name) if has_numbered_shots else list(fresh_veo)
        veo_queue = deque(veo_sorted)

        # Discover story images
        images_dir = self.story_dir / "images"
        avail_images = list(images) if images else []
        if not avail_images and images_dir.exists():
            for ext in ("scene_*.jpg", "scene_*.png", "scene_*.webp"):
                avail_images.extend(images_dir.glob(ext))
            avail_images.sort(key=lambda p: p.name)

        segments: List[VisualSegment] = []
        newly_used: List[Path] = []
        current_time = 0.0
        seg_idx = 0

        # â”€â”€ 1. CANONICAL FORMAT F1: AI OPENING + AI IMAGES â”€â”€
        if fmt_id == FormatId.F1:
            opening_dur = min(self.total_duration, F2_CHAPTER1_DURATION)
            if len(veo_sorted) > 1:
                clip_dur = opening_dur / len(veo_sorted)
                for i, v_clip in enumerate(veo_sorted):
                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=clip_dur,
                        segment_type="veo_opening",
                        source_path=v_clip,
                        description=f"F1 Opening Shot {i+1} ({clip_dur:.1f}s)",
                        source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO,
                        asset_id=v_clip.stem
                    ))
                    current_time += clip_dur
                    seg_idx += 1
            else:
                open_src = chap1_source or (veo_queue.popleft() if veo_queue else Path("placeholder_opening_ai.mp4"))
                segments.append(VisualSegment(
                    index=seg_idx,
                    start_time=0.0,
                    duration=opening_dur,
                    segment_type="veo_opening" if "veo" in str(open_src).lower() else "chap1_opening",
                    source_path=open_src,
                    description="F1 AI Opening Video",
                    source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO,
                    asset_id=Path(open_src).stem
                ))
                current_time += opening_dur
                seg_idx += 1

            img_cursor = 0
            if body_scenes:
                for s in body_scenes:
                    s_dur = float(s.get("duration", 45.0))
                    dur = min(s_dur, max(0.0, self.total_duration - current_time))
                    if dur <= 0:
                        break
                    img_src = avail_images[img_cursor % len(avail_images)] if avail_images else Path("placeholder_scene.jpg")
                    img_cursor += 1
                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=dur,
                        segment_type="slideshow",
                        source_path=img_src,
                        description=f"Scene {s.get('scene_index', seg_idx)} (Ken Burns Push-in)",
                        source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE,
                        asset_id=Path(img_src).stem
                    ))
                    current_time += dur
                    seg_idx += 1
            else:
                while current_time < self.total_duration:
                    rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                    dur = min(rem, 45.0)
                    img_src = avail_images[img_cursor % len(avail_images)] if avail_images else Path("placeholder_scene.jpg")
                    img_cursor += 1
                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=dur,
                        segment_type="slideshow",
                        source_path=img_src,
                        description=f"F1 Flow Image Scene {img_cursor} ({dur:.1f}s)",
                        source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE,
                        asset_id=Path(img_src).stem
                    ))
                    current_time += dur
                    seg_idx += 1

        # â”€â”€ 2. CANONICAL FORMAT F3: FULL AI IMAGES â”€â”€
        elif fmt_id == FormatId.F3:
            img_cursor = 0
            while current_time < self.total_duration:
                rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                dur = min(rem, 45.0)
                img_src = avail_images[img_cursor % len(avail_images)] if avail_images else Path("placeholder_scene.jpg")
                img_cursor += 1
                segments.append(VisualSegment(
                    index=seg_idx,
                    start_time=current_time,
                    duration=dur,
                    segment_type="slideshow",
                    source_path=img_src,
                    description=f"F3 Flow Image Scene {img_cursor} ({dur:.1f}s)",
                    source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE,
                    asset_id=Path(img_src).stem
                ))
                current_time += dur
                seg_idx += 1

        # â”€â”€ 3. CANONICAL FORMAT F4: REUP (ORIGINAL INSET + BACKGROUND STOCK) â”€â”€
        elif fmt_id == FormatId.F4:
            src_video = chap1_source
            if not src_video or not Path(src_video).exists():
                candidates = list(self.story_dir.glob("source_video.mp4")) + \
                             list(self.story_dir.glob("full_video.mp4")) + \
                             list(self.story_dir.glob("reup_video.mp4")) + \
                             list(self.story_dir.glob("*.mp4"))
                src_video = candidates[0] if candidates else Path("source_video.mp4")

            # Inset foreground segment
            segments.append(VisualSegment(
                index=0,
                start_time=0.0,
                duration=self.total_duration,
                segment_type="f1_framed",
                source_path=src_video,
                description="F4 Primary Source Video Inset",
                source_class=SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO,
                asset_id=Path(src_video).stem
            ))
            # The stock source remains a distinct, auditable timeline asset.
            bg_stock = stock_queue.popleft() if stock_queue else Path("placeholder_bg_stock.mp4")
            segments.append(VisualSegment(
                index=1,
                start_time=0.0,
                duration=self.total_duration,
                segment_type="stock",
                source_path=bg_stock,
                description="F4 Background Stock Canvas",
                source_class=SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE,
                asset_id=Path(bg_stock).stem
            ))

        # â”€â”€ 4. CANONICAL FORMAT F5: FULL CUSTOM VIDEO (100% STOCK_ONLINE) â”€â”€
        elif fmt_id == FormatId.F5:
            stock_cursor = 0
            while current_time < self.total_duration:
                rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                dur = min(rem, 30.0)
                if stock_queue:
                    st_src = stock_queue.popleft()
                    newly_used.append(st_src)
                else:
                    st_src = Path(f"stock_clip_{stock_cursor+1}.mp4")

                stock_cursor += 1
                segments.append(VisualSegment(
                    index=seg_idx,
                    start_time=current_time,
                    duration=dur,
                    segment_type="stock",
                    source_path=st_src,
                    description=f"F5 Stock Clip {stock_cursor} ({dur:.1f}s)",
                    source_class=SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE,
                    asset_id=Path(st_src).stem
                ))
                current_time += dur
                seg_idx += 1

        # â”€â”€ 5. CANONICAL FORMAT F2: AI OPENING + STOCK + AI VIDEO INTERLEAVE â”€â”€
        else:
            # AI Opening (~60s)
            opening_dur = min(self.total_duration, F2_CHAPTER1_DURATION)
            open_src = chap1_source or (veo_queue.popleft() if veo_queue else Path("placeholder_opening_ai.mp4"))
            segments.append(VisualSegment(
                index=seg_idx,
                start_time=0.0,
                duration=opening_dur,
                segment_type="chap1_opening",
                source_path=open_src,
                description="F2 AI Opening Video",
                source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO,
                asset_id=Path(open_src).stem
            ))
            current_time += opening_dur
            seg_idx += 1

            # Post-opening body: dynamic shot lengths, guaranteeing BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED
            # If CreativePlan is provided with ShotSpecs, follow ShotSpecs!
            if creative_plan and creative_plan.shot_specs:
                post_shots = [sh for sh in creative_plan.shot_specs if sh.shot_id != "shot_01"]
                for sh in post_shots:
                    if current_time >= self.total_duration:
                        break
                    rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                    dur = min(rem, sh.duration_sec)
                    target_cls = sh.visual_requirement.preferred_source_class if sh.visual_requirement else SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE

                    if target_cls == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE:
                        src = stock_queue.popleft() if stock_queue else Path(f"stock_{seg_idx}.mp4")
                        seg_type = "stock"
                        newly_used.append(src)
                    else:
                        src = veo_queue.popleft() if veo_queue else Path(f"veo_ai_{seg_idx}.mp4")
                        seg_type = "veo_ai"

                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=dur,
                        segment_type=seg_type,
                        source_path=src,
                        description=f"F2 Shot {sh.shot_id} [{target_cls.value}]",
                        source_class=target_cls,
                        asset_id=Path(src).stem
                    ))
                    current_time += dur
                    seg_idx += 1
            else:
                # Dynamic scene intervals derived from body_scenes or narrative pacing
                # NOT a rigid 30s alternation: intervals alternate dynamically to fulfill BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED
                slot = 0
                while current_time < self.total_duration:
                    rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                    # Dynamic varying durations between 20s and 45s
                    dur = min(rem, 25.0 if slot % 2 == 0 else 35.0)

                    # Ensure at least 1 stock and at least 1 veo post-opening
                    if slot % 2 == 0:
                        src = stock_queue.popleft() if stock_queue else Path(f"stock_{seg_idx}.mp4")
                        seg_type = "stock"
                        cls = SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE
                        newly_used.append(src)
                    else:
                        src = veo_queue.popleft() if veo_queue else Path(f"veo_ai_{seg_idx}.mp4")
                        seg_type = "veo_ai"
                        cls = SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO

                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=dur,
                        segment_type=seg_type,
                        source_path=src,
                        description=f"F2 Interval {slot+1} ({dur:.1f}s)",
                        source_class=cls,
                        asset_id=Path(src).stem
                    ))
                    current_time += dur
                    seg_idx += 1
                    slot += 1

        # Enforce exact total_duration coverage
        if current_time < self.total_duration and segments and fmt_id != FormatId.F4:
            segments[-1].duration += (self.total_duration - current_time)

        # Record newly used clips in zero-reuse registry
        if newly_used and self.story_dir.name != "dummy_story":
            record_clips(newly_used, story_name=self.story_dir.name)
